mapper.select: SELECT DATASET_ID AS datasetId , CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , DATASET_NAME AS datasetName , DATASET_TY AS datasetTy , CAST(CONFIG_JSON AS CHAR) AS configJson , USE_FL AS useFl , CREATION_ID AS creationId , DATE_FORMAT(CREATION_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS creationDt , UPDATE_ID AS updateId , DATE_FORMAT(UPDATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updateDt FROM CM_WIDGET_DATASET WHERE DATASET_ID = #{datasetId} AND CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd}
SELECT CONCAT('DATASET-', LPAD(IFNULL(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(DATASET_ID, 9) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) + 1, 5, '0')) FROM CM_WIDGET_DATASET WHERE DATASET_ID REGEXP '^DATASET-[0-9]+$' AND CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd}
